area: Phone and messaging (read-only map). Covers the Hotline call system (game module and booth view), the Collector's rescue call line, Mira's story calls, the DOM choice/subtitle/toast/panel overlay, the in-world 3D placard UI (notes, journal, deal board), the first-person viewmodel and held props, the manga portrait and dialogue box, and the i18n *.strings.ts pattern. No message-thread UI or spouse/mafia content exists yet.

risks: Do not model messages as PhoneCallState or route them through run.phone(). run.phone() feeds the broke prompt (run.ts:1740, rescue.ts:155 'phone' step), checkRescue gating (run.ts:2485), the booth lamp and deal board (machines/hotline/index.ts:228-257), the HUD ring chip (hud.ts:430-433) and the world lights (world.ts:170-171). Use new event names.

Digit key conflicts: keys 1-3 are the hotline's walk-layer deal keys (keymap.ts:45, machines/hotline/index.ts:161-167, called per frame at inGameState.ts:392), and ui.choice also takes Digit1-9 whenever a choice is up (ui.ts:979-981). Two numbered-choice surfaces at once would both react to the same key.

The hotline's phone keys are dead without a booth: phoneWalkKeys returns early when no booth exists (machines/hotline/index.ts:163-164), and answerPhoneKey is a booth method (282-289). The apartment phone (Home has no booth) must call run APIs or its own module directly.

Watch clock: the hotline does not hold the clock (run.ts:1430 checks clockHeld; only subtitle, cutscene and Mira paths hold it, e.g. roomsHost.ts:164). Reading a thread during a Watch costs Watch time unless holdClockFor is called. Messages must stay silent outside 'play' like hotline.ts:576.

Multiplayer: 'phone' and 'phoneAns' wire messages are declared (protocol.ts:188-189) with no handler found in src, and 'phone' is host-only (session.ts:65). RunSnapshot.phone (protocol.ts:74) is the only net field. Single-player is unaffected; MP needs a protocol addition.

Save and restore: new state must be an optional RunExt field with a blank default (run.ts:357-358 precedent). Restore must re-emit unread or live-thread state the way hotline.restore re-emits phone:ring for a live call (hotline.ts:639-642).
Seeded rolls: pick salts unique to messages (for example 'messages.<thread>') so they do not correlate with 'hotline.ring' (hotline.ts:556) or 'hollow.phone' (hotline.ts:550).
ui.choice returns -1 on timeout (ui.ts:426-429) and the caller must treat it as no reply. Cutscene gates already rely on this (cutscene/player.ts:298-299).
Toast kind 'phone' is typed only on UIOverlayX (ui.ts:52-56). UIOverlay.toast in types.ts:49 accepts ToastKind only, so calls must cast like brokePrompt.ts:59.
Placard3D sets input mode 'ui' and exits pointer lock (notes.ts:128-138) and adds the note-open class (placard3d.ts NOTE_OPEN_CLASS). A held phone board must close cleanly on Dawn and on run end.

Portrait additions touch three tables (portrait.ts SPECS 55 and PORTRAIT_IDS 157; manga.strings.ts 19-36 and 68-79). Missing ids fall back to the plain Mark (portrait.ts:158), so forgetting one fails quietly.

Findings for the other areas (FYI): gloves already exist on the first-person hands (viewmodel.ts:2, 78), so the director does not need a new glove model. The election-style phone chip (hud.ts:233-238) shows booth distance, so it is misleading at Home. Found no existing spouse, mafia, apartment or home content (grep). The only chat is the lobby log (menu/lobbyState.ts:94-200), not reusable in-run. The elevator (world/props/elevator.ts, cutscenes/ending_elevator) is not in this area.
suggestion:
Minimal integration plan for phone threads (spouse, mafia), read-only findings only:

1. Data and rules in a new pure module (for example src/game/messages.ts, no DOM, no three). Define threads and messages as data tables like DEALS (hotline.ts:273-412) and STORY_CALLS (story/calls.ts:18-27): MessageDef {id, thread: 'spouse'|'mafia', night?, when (a Watch index or a quota-fraction threshold), textKey, replies?: [{key, effects}]}. Each reply's effect is applied through RunApi calls (earn/spend/addDread/buffs.add/shift.extend), as the deals do (hotline.ts:244-248, 279-287, 356).

2. Scheduling: createMessages(run, opts) mirrors createHotline (hotline.ts:452-658). Start on shift:phase 'play' and stop on closing/settle/collection/intermission/over (hotline.ts:574-577). Roll per Watch with hashSeed('messages.<thread>', run.seed, night, watch) (hotline.ts:513, 556 pattern). Mafia escalation reads run:deadline and quota.due (run.ts:1477, hotline.ts:250). Timing is driven by run:clock (run.ts:1406) or by a tick(dt) called from run.ts:1409, next to hotline.tick.

3. Wiring in run.ts: create beside createHotline (run.ts:959), add an optional RunExt field beside hotline (run.ts:357-358), snapshot at run.ts:3169, restore at run.ts:3526, dispose at run.ts:1795. Emit new bus events (for example msg:in and msg:reply, declared by module augmentation as hotline.ts:36-41 does). Do not reuse phone:ring, phone:end or run.phone().

4. Reply UI, two options:
   a. Quick replies: ui.choice(title, options, {timeout}) (ui.ts:759-764). Digit keys are shared with the hotline (see risks), so only use it when no hotline board is up.
   b. Full thread view: a Placard3D board held up with the phone, following story/notes.ts present() and closeStage() (128-141) and PlacardSpec (placard3d.ts:153-180). Hold the phone in the viewmodel with viewmodel.hold('phone') (viewmodel.ts:244-246, 332). Clickable reply regions use placard regions and act strings.

5. Opening the phone: a new walk action in EXTRA_BINDINGS (keymap.ts:41-46) with labels in keymap.strings.ts:21 and 52, read per frame like inGameState.ts:392. Pick a key other than KeyP and digits, or gate KeyP on whether a hotline call is live.

6. Notifications: toast kind 'phone' via the UIOverlayX cast (ui.ts:39, 56, 69; ui.css:442-443). Optionally an unread count on the HUD chip (hud.ts:233-238), driven by the new events rather than phone:ring.

7. Strings: messages.strings.ts with prefix 'messages.' (en and tr, pattern hotline.strings.ts:5-6). Speaker labels go in the story.strings.ts speaker.* style (25-29, 108-112). The spouse portrait needs a SPECS entry (portrait.ts:55), PORTRAIT_IDS (157) and who/title keys (manga.strings.ts 19-36, 68-79). Show it through dialogue() or a thread avatar via portraitSrc.

8. Home-phone input: the booth-bound handlers (machines/hotline/index.ts:161-167, 282-289) do nothing without a booth, so the apartment phone should call run APIs directly.

9. Tests: a scripts/tests/messages.test.mjs using the hotline.test.mjs harness (lines 1-30, mockRun).
